title: Proposed Communist Demonstration On March 29, 1934

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
FURTHER REPORT
File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. S. REGISTRY.
No. D 5776
Date April 3, 1934.
Date 3 / 4 / 34
Subject (in full) Proposed communist demonstration on March 29, 1934.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by (签名)
With reference to the attached report containing
information from the Chinese Authorities on a proposed
demonstration to be staged by local "Reds" in the vicinity
of Markham Road Bridge on March 29, 1934, in commemoration
of the Anniversary of the Execution of 72 Martyrs in the
Canton Uprising in 1911, I have to state that nothing untoward
occurred.
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.
(批：签名)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特务科。
补充报告
档案号：工部局警务处
C. & S. S. 登记处。
编号 D 5776
日期 1934年4月3日。
日期 3 / 4 / 34
主题（全称） 关于1934年3月29日拟举行的共产党示威活动。
由 副督察 顾宝华 呈报 转发人 （签名）

鉴于所附报告中包含来自中国当局的情报，称当地“赤色分子”拟于1934年3月29日在马克姆路（Markham Road）桥附近举行示威活动，以纪念1911年广州起义中72烈士就义周年，本人谨此声明，期间未发生任何异常事件。

顾宝华
副督察，
特务科。
（批注：签名）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. S. REGISTRY. No. D 5776 Date March 29, 1934. Date 3 / 1 / 34）

Subject (in full) Information from Public Safety Bureau re proposed communist demonstration.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

At 5 p.m. March 29, 1934 a telephone message was received at this office from Mr. Liu Hwa, Officer i/c Special Branch of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, stating that he has received an unconfirmed report to the effect that certain communist adherents will hold a "flying" meeting in the vicinity of Markham Road Bridge between 7 and 8 p.m. to-day (March 29) in commemoration of the anniversary of the execution of 72 martyrs in the Canton Uprising in 1911.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Singu Station informed. [签名] 29/3.
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

S2
Mihai
[签名]
Informed: D.I. Kuh.
From a box tin.
[签名] 1/4.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. S. 登记处。编号 D 5776 日期 1934年3月29日。日期 3 / 1 / 34）

主题（全称） 来自公安局关于拟举行的共产党示威活动的情报。

由 副督察 顾宝华 呈报 转发人 [签名]

1934年3月29日下午5时，本办公室接到上海市公安局特务科科长刘华（Liu Hwa）先生的电话留言，称其收到一份未经证实的报告，内容指某些共产党追随者将于今日（3月29日）晚上7时至8时之间，在马克姆路（Markham Road）桥附近举行一次“飞行集会”，以纪念1911年广州起义中72烈士就义周年。

顾宝华
副督察。

已通知辛家花园巡捕房。[签名] 3/29。
副督察，
特务科。

S2
米海（Mihai）
[签名]
已告知：副督察 顾。

[签名] 4/1。

No. D 5776
Date 30 / 3 / 34

March 30 - April 3, 34.

Political

Anniversary of the Execution of the 72 Participants of
the Kwangtung Uprising in 1911 - local observance

The above Anniversary apart from being observed as a
holiday by Chinese official organs, schools and most of
the public bodies, was marked by the holding of memorial
meetings under the auspices of the Kuomintang at its
headquarters, Feng Ling Jao, off Route Chisi, and the
5th District Kuomintang at Pootung. During the course
of the gathering, the Glorious* deeds of the martyrs
were reiterated and slogans of the usual Kuomintung
order shouted.

编号 D 5776

1934年3月30日至4月3日。

政治类

1911年广东起义72名参与者就义周年——本地纪念情况

上述周年纪念日除被中国官方机构、学校及大多数公共团体作为假日纪念外，还表现为在国民党总部（位于祁齐路（Route Chisi）旁的凤林角（Feng Ling Jao））以及浦东第五区国民党党部主持下举行纪念集会。在集会过程中，与会者反复颂扬烈士的*光荣*事迹，并高呼通常的国民党口号。

Date 30. 3. 34）

March 30, 1934.    5-    Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers;

ANNIVERSARY OF THE DEATH OF 72 MARTYRS

A memorial meeting was held yesterday, the
Anniversary of the Death of the 72 Martyrs at Huang
Hua Kong in Kwangtung, under the auspices of the local
Tangpu, at the Auditorium of the Party Headquarters.
Some 200 persons representing the Peace Preservation Corps,
the Shanghai-Woosung Garrison Commander's Headquarters,
the various Bureaux of the Shanghai City Government, the
law courts, the Customs and various schools, were present.
All official organs and schools and a number
of business houses closed for the day and national flags
were flown at half-mast.
For fear that criminal elements might take
advantage of the occasion to create disturbances, the
Military and Police authorities instructed their subor-
dinates to carry out special precautions on that day,
while additional Police were posted at the boundaries
between Chinese territory and the Concession and the
Settlement.

1934年3月30日。    5-    晨间译文。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸；

72烈士殉难周年

昨日，在当地党部的主持下，于党部总部礼堂举行了纪念集会，以纪念在广东黄花岗（Huang Hua Kong）殉难的72烈士周年忌日。约有200人出席，代表包括保安队、上海吴淞要塞司令部、上海市政府各局、法院、海关及各学校。
所有官方机构和学校以及许多商号当日停业，国旗降半旗志哀。
出于担心犯罪分子可能利用此机会制造骚乱，军警当局指示其下属在当日采取特别预防措施，同时在中国辖区与租界及公共租界的边界增派了警力。
